description: Desktop-shell chrome on bundled/local pages: drag-region dragging, window theme mirroring (web page is the theme authority), double-click-to-maximize on the top strip.

Desktop-shell chrome for the remote harness UI (http://127.0.0.1): dragging, double-click-to-maximize and window-theme mirroring. The harness page is a remote origin, so these core:window commands must be granted via a remote capability.
